name: Ordinal Number Fixation
effect: Pushes ordinal numbers and centuries into everything ('10th', '70th', 'thirteenth eleventh hour', '21st-century'), often in endless loops such as 'the 10th of the 10th of the 10th'. Names get corrupted ('Romeoth the 95th', 'the th-e model')
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs.
